sections.Profile:
Crown Soccer Special, produced by Taito in July 1967, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed for head-to-head play, simulating a soccer match between two players positioned at opposite ends of the playfield. Each player controls two flippers facing their opponent, aiming to score goals while defending their own. The game features four flippers, four pop bumpers, and two kick-out holes, with a constantly moving goalkeeper adding to the challenge.

- Manufacturer: Taito
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Soccer, Head-to-Head, Sports, Original Theme
